title: ContextSafe laboratory result set 0.1
description: Reference-only and ungoverned. A set of laboratory result observations for one synthetic case. Every analyte code, unit, bound, and flag in a document of this shape is a fixture token invented for software tests: no laboratory medical director, clinical reviewer, or community reviewer has approved any of them, and nothing here is a reference-interval recommendation for any analyte, person, or population. docs/05-DATA-AND-EVIDENCE.md section 4 is where a partner's laboratory medical director supplies the real fixture values.
$comment: A laboratory result is a separate observation kind, not a sixth canonical concept: gender_identity, recorded_sex_or_gender, sex_parameter_for_clinical_use, name_to_use, and pronouns are unchanged by this contract and no field here is derived from, or may be substituted for, any of them. A result reaches no receipt, so the receipt contract's closed outcome-reason set and structural-pointer vocabulary are untouched. JSON Schema validates structure; contextsafe.laboratory additionally enforces the x-contextsafe-semantic-constraints below.
x-contextsafe-semantic-constraints: every result's case_id equals the case document's case_id
a result identifier appears at most once in the set
a typed reference interval admits at least one decimal: low is not above high, and equal bounds require both to be inclusive
a source pointer is built only from contextsafe.validation.STRUCTURAL_POINTER_SEGMENTS; an importer points a result at the row it read, never at a cell
no field here is read as, derived from, or written into any Gender Harmony concept

decimal.description: A decimal carried as a string: optional sign, bounded digits, no exponent. Compared exactly, never as a float.

resultToken.description: An analyte code, value, or unit as the source carried it: a bounded token with no whitespace. Bounding what a token may look like says nothing about what it means; binding it to an approved analyte or unit is a mapping profile's job, and no profile is reviewed.

referenceInterval.description: What the source returned where a reference interval belongs. absent: it returned nothing. not_typed: it returned something in a dialect this ungoverned profile cannot type, which is a different fact from absence and is never guessed at. typed: bounds, inclusivity, and a unit, all present.

abnormalFlag.description: What the source returned where an abnormal flag belongs. The typed vocabulary is invented for fixtures and is deliberately not any laboratory's flag alphabet; a partner's own flag is not_typed until a reviewed mapping profile binds it.

source_pointer.description: Where in its source the result was read from. Structural only; never a source value. The words are the same closed vocabulary the observation set is held to.
